source: Verified against GGD Modern & Massive 'GM' preset (Mapping tab, user-confirmed July 2026)
notes: Verified against Modern & Massive only: select the 'GM' mapping preset in the plugin (not Halpern or the default 'GGD' preset). Kick/snare/crash/rack tom match exactly (36/38/49/50). Our floor tom (45) and single-tom fallback (47) both remap to 43 (Floor Tom 1) — a judgment call: GGD's GM preset also has Floor Tom 2 at 41, but this pipeline emits at most two tom voices and cannot distinguish more than floor vs rack. Other GGD library titles may place floor toms differently; verify in the Mapping tab.
